### [Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic&#x27;s Long-Term Benefit Trust](https://www.anthropic.com/news/christopher-stubbs-joins-long-term-benefit-trust)

**Anthropic** · 2026-10-21

Experimental physicist and former Harvard Dean of Science Dr. Christopher Stubbs has joined Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust as its fifth trustee.

- Dr. Christopher Stubbs brings scientific expertise from observational cosmology, precision measurement, and government advisory roles via JASON.
- Stubbs's recent academic work focuses on addressing the reproducibility of AI-assisted scientific research when models yield variable outputs.
- The Long-Term Benefit Trust operates independently of management and investors, holding authority to appoint a majority of Anthropic's board of directors.
- The Trust helped define five mission pillars used in Anthropic's initial Public Benefit Report and will oversee a proposed Anthropic Public Benefit Fund share equity allocation.

**Why it matters:** Stubbs's appointment integrates expertise in scientific reproducibility and defense advisory into the independent governance body tasked with overseeing Anthropic's board and long-term AI safety commitments.
